PS1:asonde-aiueo.d: Asonde AIUEO is an educational / mini games game for the PlayStation, published by Gakken (Gakushuu Kenkyuusha) in 2003.

PS1:baldies.d: Baldies is a 1995 real-time strategy video game developed by Creative Edge Software and originally published by Atari Corporation for the Atari Jaguar CD. It was later ported to the PC, PlayStation, Sega Saturn, and Macintosh. In the game, the player manages a community of Baldies in order to build structures, increase their population, and create weapons to fight against enemies known as Hairies. There are four classes of Baldies and each structure has specific properties to assist the player. Its gameplay combines strategy with simulation and god game elements.

PS1:dead-or-alive.d: Dead or Alive (Japanese: DEAD OR ALIVE(デッド オア アライブ), Hepburn: Deddo oa Araibu; abbreviated as DOA) is a Japanese media franchise centered on a series of fighting games developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo (formerly Tecmo). The gameplay of the series is primarily composed of fast-paced hand-to-hand combat in a three-dimensional playing field that began with the first game released in 1996, followed by five main sequels, numerous updates, spin-offs, printed media, a film adaptation, and merchandise. Set in the modern day, the series revolves around the events of the Dead or Alive World Combat Championship, an international martial arts tournament in which fighters from…

PS1:deep-sea-adventure-kaitei-kyuu-panta.d: Deep Sea Adventure: Kaitei-kyuu Pantarassa no Nazo is an action / shooter / adventure game for the PlayStation, published by Takara in 1999.

PS1:disney-peter-pan-aventuras-na-terra-.d: Disney Peter Pan: Aventuras na Terra do Nunca is a platformer game for the PlayStation, published by Sony in 2002.

PS1:everybody-s-golf.d: Everybody's Golf, released in North America as Hot Shots Golf and in Japan as Minna no Golf, is a 1997 golf video game developed by Camelot Software Planning and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation. It is the first game in the Everybody's Golf series and the only one to be developed by Camelot, who would later develop the Mario Golf series for Nintendo; Clap Hanz would develop later installments starting with Everybody's Golf 2.

PS1:gran-turismo-2-music-at-the-speed-of.st: Music at the Speed of Sound - The Album (Bonus PlayStation Disc)
PS1:gran-turismo-2-music-at-the-speed-of.d: Gran Turismo 2 is a 1999 sim racing video game developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation. It is the sequel to Gran Turismo, the second installment of the Gran Turismo series, and the first video game to be developed by Polyphony Digital. Gran Turismo 2 was a critical and commercial success, shipping 1.73 million units in Asia, 3.96 million units in North America, and 3.68 million units in Europe for a total of 9.37 million units as of April 30, 2008, and eventually becoming a Sony Greatest Hits game.

PS1:harukanaru-toki-no-naka-de-banjou-yu.d: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Banjou Yuugi is a board / adventure / rpg game for the PlayStation, published by Koei in 2003.

PS1:kinniku-banzuke-vol-3-saikyou-no-cha.d: Kinniku Banzuke Vol. 3: Saikyou no Challenger Tanjou! is a tv game show game for the PlayStation, published by Konami in 2001.

PS1:monaco-grand-prix.d: Monaco Grand Prix: Racing Simulation 2, also known simply as Monaco Grand Prix or Racing Simulation: Monaco Grand Prix, is a Formula One racing game developed and published by Ubisoft for Windows, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, and Dreamcast. It was released between 1998 and 1999. A sequel, Racing Simulation 3, was released in 2002.

PS1:ncaa-march-madness-2000.d: NCAA March Madness 2000 is the 1999 installment in the NCAA March Madness series. Former Maryland player Steve Francis is featured on the cover.

PS1:nice-price-series-vol-02-honkaku-sho.d: Nice Price Series Vol. 02: Honkaku Shougi Shinan is a shogi game for the PlayStation, published by Digicube in 2001.

PS1:sangokushi-eiketsuden.d: Sangokushi Eiketsuden is a strategy video game for the PlayStation, published by Koei in 1995.

PS1:teitoku-no-ketsudan-2.d: Teitoku no Ketsudan II is a strategy game for the PlayStation, published by KOEI in 1998.

PS1:the-dalmatians.d: The Dalmatians is a puzzle game for the PlayStation, published by Midas Interactive in 2000.

PS1:the-open-golf-history-of-turnberry.d: The Open Golf: History of Turnberry is a sports - golf game for the PlayStation, published by Banpresto in 1996.

PS1:wagamama-fairy-mirumo-de-pon-mirumo-.d: Wagamama Fairy Mirumo de Pon! Mirumo no Mahou Gakkou Monogatari is an adventure / mini games game for the PlayStation, published by Konami in 2003.

PS1:welcome-house-2-keaton-and-his-uncle.d: Welcome House 2: Keaton and His Uncle is an adventure game for the PlayStation, published by Gust in 1996.

PS2:buzz-the-sports-quiz.d: Buzz!: The Sports Quiz is a 2006 party video game developed by Kuju Entertainment and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 2. It is the third instalment in the Buzz! series and the first not to be developed by Relentless Software. Like the Buzz!: The Music Quiz, it was released only in Europe and Australia.

PS2:k-1-world-max-2005.d: K-1 World Max 2005 is a sports video game for the PlayStation 2.

PS2:panic-palette.d: Panic Palette is an otome game for the PlayStation 2, published by Takuyo in 2007.

PS2:red-ninja-end-of-honor.d: Red Ninja: End of Honor, known in Japan as Kurenai Shinobu: Kekka no Mai (紅忍 血河の舞, Kurenai Shinobu Kekka no Mai; "Crimson Ninja: Blood River Dance"), is a 2005 video game for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox platforms, created in a collaboration between the game developer Tranji Studios (now ERTAIN Corporation) and the film writer Shinsuke Sato. It was published by Vivendi Universal Games. The game's theme song "Foolish Dream" was performed by Yoko Ishida. The game was poorly received and was Tranji Studios' only published title.

PS2:romancing-saga.d: Romancing SaGa is a role-playing video game for the PlayStation 2, published by Square Enix.

PS2:sangokushi-senki.d: Sangokushi Senki is a strategy video game for the PlayStation 2, published by Koei in 2002.

PS2:tenchu-kurenai.d: Tenchu: Fatal Shadows (published in Japan as "Tenchu Kurenai") is an action-adventure stealth video game developed by K2 and published by FromSoftware in Japan and Sega in North America and Europe for the PlayStation 2 in 2004. The PlayStation Portable version of the game, Tenchu Kurenai Portable, was released in Japan in 2010.

PS3:call-of-juarez-the-cartel.d: Call of Juarez: The Cartel is a 2011 first-person shooter for PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360. Developed by Techland and originally published by Ubisoft, the PlayStation and Xbox versions were released in June 2011 and the Windows version in September. It is the third game in the Call of Juarez series, although narratively, it is unrelated to the two previous games (Call of Juarez and Call of Juarez: Bound in Blood). Unlike previous entries, which were set in the Old West, The Cartel is set in modern-day Los Angeles and Mexico.

PS3:last-guy-the.d: The Last Guy is a 2008 maze video game developed and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3. It is available as a downloadable game on the PlayStation Store. The game is a rescue game in which the eponymous player character must guide civilians to escape from monster-infested cities. Following the Japan-exclusive release of a demo titled The Last Guy Premium Japan on July 31, 2008, the full game was released in all territories on August 28, 2008.

PS3:mass-effect.d: Mass Effect is a military science fiction media franchise created by Casey Hudson. The franchise depicts a distant future where humanity and several alien civilizations have colonized the galaxy using technology left behind by advanced precursor civilizations. The franchise originated in a series of video games developed by BioWare and originally published by Microsoft Game Studios on the first two games and its expansions. Later on, the series was taken over by Electronic Arts through its acquisition of BioWare.

PS3:metal-gear-solid-3-snake-eater-hd-ed.d: 2011 video game developed by Konami Digital Entertainment.

PS3:pac-man-and-the-ghostly-adventures.w: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures (video game)
PS3:pac-man-and-the-ghostly-adventures.d: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures, also known in Japan as Pac-World is a 3D platform video game based on the TV series of the same name which aired on Disney XD from 2013 to 2015. It was released for the Xbox 360, Windows, PlayStation 3, and Wii U in October 2013, and was later released for the Nintendo 3DS in November of that year. The console and PC versions were developed by Vicious Cycle Software under their Monkey Bar Games division and the 3DS version was developed by Inti Creates. Both versions were published by Namco Bandai Games.

PS3:robert-ludlum-s-the-bourne-conspirac.d: Robert Ludlum's The Bourne Conspiracy is a third-person action video game developed by High Moon Studios and published by Vivendi Games for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. The game expands upon Robert Ludlum's character Jason Bourne. The game was released in North America on June 3, June 5 in Australia and June 27, 2008, in Europe. It received mixed to positive reviews.

PS3:rocksmith-all-new-2014-edition.d: Rocksmith is a music video game produced by Ubisoft, released in October 2011 for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 platforms in North America. Rocksmith was released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 during September 2012 in Australian and European markets and October 2012 in Japan. A Windows version was released on October 16, 2012, after several delays. The game's main feature is that, unlike other rhythm games such as Guitar Hero that require proprietary controllers to play, Rocksmith instead allows players to plug in virtually any electric guitar and play along via a USB adapter.

PS3:winning-eleven-2018.d: Pro Evolution Soccer 2018 (abbreviated as PES 2018) is a sports video game developed and published by Konami for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Android and iOS. The game is the 17th installment in the Pro Evolution Soccer series and was released worldwide in September 2017. This was the final PES game released for PlayStation 3 & Xbox 360 consoles and the last to feature UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, and UEFA Super Cup licenses and the Borussia Dortmund partnership. To mark its occasion, Konami recreated the "Ultimate Stage" stadium, as shown in the UEFA Champions League 2015-18 brand. A mobile game version was released as PES 2018…

PS3:zombie-apocalypse.d: Zombie Apocalypse is a 2009 downloadable action shoot 'em up video game developed by Nihilistic Software and published by Konami. In 2011, a sequel was released, Zombie Apocalypse: Never Die Alone.

PSP:valhalla-knights-2.d: Valhalla Knights 2 (ヴァルハラ ナイツ, Varuhara Naitsu Ni) is a role-playing video game developed by K2 and published by Marvelous Entertainment for the PlayStation Portable. It is the sequel to Valhalla Knights.
